page_note: Page 14 contains NO cosmological substrate. The entire page is hagiographic/apostolic frame material: (1) a tree simile applied to the Church, (2) the Saviour Christ ascending and sending the Paraclete to the apostleship, (3) a Gospel of John citation about the Paraclete convicting the world of sin, righteousness and judgment, and (4) Mani's autobiographical account — born in the years of Artabanus king of Parthia, growing up in Persia, the Living Paraclete descending to him. This is the foundational apostolic-biographical layer of the Kephalaia preface. Heavy physical damage (78.1%). Teaching purity 0.000.
